title: Disability Compensation Retroactive Releases: Signature Threshold and Fee Withholding Rate
content:
Two figures apply to every retroactive release of Disability Compensation, at every tier from Disability Compensation (10% Combined Rating) through Disability Compensation (100% Combined Rating):

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Gross retroactive amount at or above which a second authorizer must sign before release | 25000.00 USD |
| Share of past-due benefits withheld for direct payment of an accredited attorney or agent under a direct-pay fee agreement | 20 percent |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical gross amounts)**

- A release of 24999.99 is below the threshold and goes out on one authorizer's signature.
- A release of exactly 25000.00 meets the threshold and needs a second signature; so does 31250.40.

**Fee illustration (hypothetical).** On past-due benefits of 8000.00 with a direct-pay fee agreement on file, 20 percent, that is 1600.00, is withheld for the representative's fee.
